acquisition method: We performed AP-MS to identify the interacting partners of KCTD7.
enrichment method: the WCLs were incubated with anti-FLAG antibody-conjugated M2 agarose beads (Sigma-Aldrich) at 4°C overnight to capture FLAG-tagged KCTD7.
fractionation method: the eluted proteins were separated by SDS–polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (PAGE) on a gradient gel (Bio-Rad) for Coomassie blue staining.
labeling: Protein bands were excised from the gel and subjected to sequencing by MS.
